fields.name: path
recommendations: Set path: /imports/*.csv (local) or a remote glob (sftp)

fields.name: strict_host_key
fields.doc: Verify the SFTP host key against host_key_fingerprint

fields.name: host_key_fingerprint
fields.doc: SFTP host key fingerprint (SHA256:… as ssh-keygen -lf prints it)

required_when.when: kind is sftp and strict_host_key is not off

recommendations: Read it with `ssh-keyscan -p <port> <host> | ssh-keygen -lf -` (the run's refusal prints the same), confirm it out of band, then set host_key_fingerprint: "SHA256:…"

fields.name: suffix
fields.doc: File suffix filter for s3 (empty = no filter)

fields.name: archive_path
fields.doc: Relocation target for after_process=archive|move — canonical home is spec level; a transport-level value wins if both are set (one-shot style)

fields.name: archive_bucket
fields.doc: S3 archive bucket for after_process=archive|move (default: source bucket)

fields.name: archive_prefix
fields.doc: S3 archive key prefix for after_process=archive|move

fields.name: key_env
fields.doc: Env var for SSH private key (SFTP)

fields.name: access_key_env
fields.doc: Env var for AWS access key (S3)

fields.name: secret_key_env
fields.doc: Env var for AWS secret key (S3)

at_least_one_of.hint: Use `lm secret set <NAME> ...` then reference it via key_env: <NAME>

refused.name: file_filter
refused.message: file_filter is not read by connector runs
recommendations: Drop it from the connector manifest

refused.name: pre_process
refused.message: pre_process is not read by connector runs
recommendations: Drop it from the connector manifest

refused.name: post_process
refused.message: post_process is not read by connector runs
recommendations: Drop it from the connector manifest

refused.name: max_file_size
refused.message: max_file_size is not read by connector runs
recommendations: Drop it from the connector manifest

fields.name: delimiter
fields.doc: Field delimiter (single char) — auto-detected if absent

fields.name: escape
fields.doc: Escape character for a quote inside a quoted value (single char, e.g. \) — absent means the quote is doubled (RFC 4180); DisplayTag and MySQL OUTFILE use a backslash

fields.name: lines
fields.doc: One line = one row, one column (`line`): no delimiter, no quoting — fixed-width files, logs

fields.name: short_rows
fields.doc: A line with fewer values than the declared columns: error (dead letter, default) or skip-leading (skipped while the table has not begun: a key;value block before it)

fields.name: columns

required_when.when: has_header is false and lines is off

recommendations: Add parser.columns: [code, name, ...] in file order

fields.name: after_process
fields.doc: What to do after a file is processed

fields.name: mapping
fields.doc: Dataset/row/cell transformer hooks — see the transformers page

fields.name: window
fields.doc: Fence scheduled runs to a UTC time window, HH:MM-HH:MM (a manual run bypasses it)

fields.name: refresh
fields.doc: Full refresh of one local file: the removal guard

fields.name: max_removed
fields.doc: Largest share of the table one run may remove: a percentage (30% by default), or off

fields.name: indexes
fields.doc: Postgres indexes on the hub table
recommendations: indexes is a list of { columns: [...], unique?: bool } objects — e.g. indexes: [{ columns: [email] }]

fields.name: columns
fields.doc: Columns of the index, in order
